editorialNarrative.formCopy: Kai Allen set the fastest lap in Thursday's opening practice, an early signal rather than a qualifying verdict. Toyota arrive after Chaz Mostert and Fabian Coulthard's Bend 500 win and a clean finish for all five Supras. Supercars has now approved a Mustang engine adjustment after testing identified power loss at lower barometric pressure; it applies here only, with Chevrolet and Toyota engines unchanged.
editorialNarrative.closingCopy: Toyota supporters have a reason to believe the new badge can challenge established rivals, but 1000 kilometres asks more than The Bend did. Ford's engine change adds another layer to the parity debate without predicting a winner. Brodie Kostecki and Todd Hazelwood also have a human adjustment: Tom Moore replaces injured engineer George Commins, drawing on an existing working relationship rather than starting from zero.
